jyutping: hing1 fan5 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is ecstatic or extremely excited.

examples.english: They were rapturous after receiving a big gift and could not sleep all night.
examples.traditional: 佢收到份大禮，興奮到不得了，成晚都瞓唔着。
